clusters.theme: Substrate-unique folded-Bogoliubov bispectrum SHAPE template at 21-cm l_max~10^5, discriminating framework from LCDM at HERA-II / SKA-1 / SKA-2 sensitivities. All five items share the same observable (folded-triangle bispectrum shape, not amplitude), same input (W4-38 folded channel alpha = -0.080), same detection threshold (SNR >= 2), and same target scale (l_max ~ 10^5). Item 131 extends the core computation with explicit per-platform independence scoring across HERA-II, SKA-1, SKA-2 rather than proposing a distinct observable; it is a scope superset of the forecast, not a separate gate.
clusters.canonical_what: Compute the substrate-unique folded-Bogoliubov bispectrum SHAPE template at 21-cm l_max~10^5; distinguish from generic equilateral/orthogonal templates; forecast per-platform SNR for HERA-II, SKA-1, SKA-2 with explicit cross-platform independence scoring (PASS = SNR >= 2 on at least one platform; confirmation level requires independence across 2+ platforms).
clusters.canonical_inputs: W4-38 .npz (folded-Bogoliubov channel alpha = -0.080); 21cmFAST or equivalent forecast tools; GGE bispectrum derivation chain; substrate squeezed-state two-point function from W3-34 A_s pin-map; HERA-II + SKA-1 + SKA-2 intensity-mapping l_max~10^5 covariances.
clusters.merge_rationale: All items compute the same observable (folded-triangle SHAPE, not amplitude), use the same physical input (W4-38 folded channel = -0.080), target the same scale (21-cm l_max ~ 10^5), and pre-register against the same SNR threshold. Four independent reviewer origins (mack, tesla, transit, little-red-dots) converged on the single computation, establishing it as the sole surviving non-Gaussianity discriminant after W4-43 closed the amplitude-running channel. Item 131 adds cross-platform independence scoring as a scope extension, not a separate gate.
